priorityList: Channel Algeth'ar Puzzle Box if equipped
Never cast the same ability twice in a row to maintain Mastery: Combo Strikes.
Cast Strike of the Windlord on cooldown for massive AoE damage and to spend Chi toward Flurry Strikes.
Cast Whirling Dragon Punch as soon as it becomes available (requires Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick to be on cooldown).
Cast Fists of Fury on cooldown, ensuring it completes its full channel.
Cast Spinning Crane Kick whenever Dance of Chi-Ji procs.
Cast Rising Sun Kick to put it on cooldown, enabling Whirling Dragon Punch and generating Teachings of the Monastery stacks.
Cast Blackout Kick to spend Teachings of the Monastery stacks and reduce the cooldown of Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick.
Cast Tiger Palm if you have less than 5 Chi and are about to cap Energy.
Cast Spinning Crane Kick as a filler in AoE (3+ targets) when no higher priority abilities are available.
